product_name: Motorola Voice D8712 Wireless Phone System with 2 Digital Handsets + Bluetooth for Cellphone, Answering Machine, Call Pad - Black
description: Work or Home Phone: The D8712 is a black cordless phone system with built-in answering machine ideal for offices and home use Hands-free conversations - The wireless phone combo features hands-free so you can take calls without a handset and multitask during meetings or chatting with friends Multi-contact Phonebook - Phone system holds up to 1,000 inputs and includes a built-in answering machine convenient for receiving messages when you're unavailable MOBILE SYNC - Phone offers call blocking for up to 1,000 numbers and features Bluetooth that allows you to connect up to two (2) mobile devices so you can sync phone books Includes: Two (2) Wireless Handsets with Base, Four (4) Batteries, Two (2) Power Adapters, Setup Guide
